description: This file declares functions for creating ASN.1 public key objects such as RSA, DSA, and DH public keys, as well as key pairs. It is an API header related to ASN.1 object representations for cryptographic keys.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreatePublicKey
methods.description: Creates a public key object (either DSA or RSA).

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateRSAPublicKey
methods.description: Creates an RSA public key object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateDSAPublicKey
methods.description: Creates a DSA public key object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateDHPublicKey
methods.description: Creates a Diffie-Hellman public key object.

methods.name: AnscAsn1CreateKeyPair
methods.description: Creates a key pair object containing key type, public key, and private key.
